candidate.display_label: Darwin Agents v0.16 empirical-Bernstein time-uniform per-test gate

grade.production_gain_validation_of_eb_gate: C / not applicable to cited March-June gains
grade.cross_candidate_global_error_control: C / not established in inspected promotion path

published_or_project_claim: darwin-agents v0.16.0, released 2026-08-15, adds confidenceMethod='eb', a predictable plug-in empirical-Bernstein confidence sequence attributed to Waudby-Smith & Ramdas.

The project reports constant 0.10 vs 0.95 decisive at n=21/arm; tight sigma≈0.05 gap 0.30 at about 59; gap 0.20 at about 89; judge-noise sigma≈0.10 gap 0.10 at about 188, with much larger Hoeffding sample requirements.
The project presents EB as a within-comparison time-uniform solution to repeated looks and states that fleet-scale composite deltas around 0.009 remain practically unresolved.
official_artifact_support: Public package metadata reports version 0.16.0 and a deterministic TypeScript test suite.

src/evolution/sequential.ts implements ebTwoSample and ebIntervalForArm using the predictable prefix-dependent bet, regularized variance proxy, psi_E penalty, two per-arm confidence sequences, full two-arm alpha budget, and fail-closed range/option checks.

tests/sequential-eb.test.ts independently transcribes the paper formula, checks a finite-support supermartingale inequality grid, performs seeded continuous-peeking type-I simulations, and pins the published decision-point bands.

src/evolution/safety.ts dispatches to ebTwoSample only when requireConfidence=true and confidenceMethod='eb'. DEFAULT_SAFETY does not enable requireConfidence or EB, so the stronger gate is opt-in rather than zero-config behavior.

independent_replay_this_audit.method: Fresh independent Python transcription from the public formulas/test protocol; the project's JavaScript implementation was not executed.

continuous_peeking_type_i_protocol_repla.scope: Consistent with the repository's <=0.05 assertions, but not a sharp estimate of achieved type-I level.

independent_replay_this_audit.approximation_note: Independent replay produced median 187 for the project-labeled 'about 188' judge-noise case; this is inside the official pinned band [120,240] and is not a substantive mismatch.

independent_external_replication: No clearly protocol-matched third-party rerun of darwin-agents v0.16 EB was located in this audit. Absence of a located rerun is not evidence that none exists.
scope_corrections: The EB guarantee is per ongoing comparison under bounded observations and the theorem's stable conditional-mean/martingale-style assumptions; 'no i.i.d. assumption' does not mean arbitrary nonstationary target drift or arm/task confounding is covered.

Time-uniform validity within one incumbent/challenger comparison does not by itself control familywise error across an adaptive sequence of distinct future challengers. No cumulative alpha/e-value/wealth ledger was established in the inspected SafetyGate/default-config/current-public promotion path.
The stronger EB gate is opt-in: requireConfidence must be enabled and confidenceMethod set to 'eb'. It should not be described as Darwin's default statistical behavior.
The cited fleet gains from March-June 2026 predate the 2026-08-15 EB release and therefore cannot validate the EB promotion rule.

For illustration only, K independent exact level-0.05 candidate tests have familywise crossing probability 1-(0.95)^K (about 40.1% at K=10); this is not an estimate of Darwin's dependent adaptive process.

theory_reference.title: Estimating means of bounded random variables by betting
theory_reference.scope_used: bounded process with stable conditional mean and predictable betting sequence

integration_guidance.safe_positive: Strong evidence that darwin-agents v0.16 implements and mechanically tests a per-comparison predictable empirical-Bernstein confidence-sequence gate, and that the public decision-point examples are reproducible from the disclosed formulas/protocol.
integration_guidance.safe_negative_or_unknown: Do not infer global error control across successive adaptive challengers, default use of EB, or empirical validation of EB from the earlier fleet gains. Independent protocol-matched third-party deployment replication was not located.

exact_next_action: At the next bootstrap-valid continuation, keep C14 immutable and audit a different exact sealed non-evaluation C14 candidate with executable official material, preferring scientist_agents, reasoning, or open_source. Do not revisit Darwin EB unless a global cross-candidate budget, a protocol-matched independent deployment rerun, or materially changed public code appears.
